reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one where I can see a named lab and the report for my batch. No oxide and a clear 200 mg dose is what I check for. I'd try one box at the launch price of $24.99, after I open the report.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and I can't tell if the lab report is real until I read it. I also don't know yet who the lab is or whether the reviews are real, since it's a new brand with only 1,000 boxes.
would_change_my_mind: If the named lab turned out to be unknown, or the report on the page didn't match the batch number, I'd skip it.
